requests.name: TASK009 Organic03 G natural flesh bite
requests.prompt: Natural close-microphone foley of one bite into dense soft flesh. A brief subdued fleshy contact, moist pressure and irregular tiny tissue details, then an organic decay. Real acoustic recording in a quiet dry Foley studio, realistic modern film sound, full frequency detail, natural dynamics. One physical event. No shoe squeak, cloth scrape, ringing, synthetic bass, distortion, pitch modulation, retro effect, speech or music.

requests.name: TASK009 Organic03 H torso injury
requests.prompt: Realistic cinema injury foley: one solid hit to a human torso, compact bodily compression under natural skin contact, slight wetness and a loose organic tissue decay. Close dry microphone, acoustic source, subtle irregular details and real dynamics, restrained rather than exaggerated gore. One impact. No fabric swish, footstep, mechanical click, electronic effect, retro style, distortion, speech or music.

requests.name: TASK009 Organic03 I bite and release
requests.prompt: Natural close-mic wound foley: a single firm bite catches soft flesh and releases, with moist compression and a very brief sticky tissue separation. Restrained human-scale physical weight, broad natural frequencies, modern film realism in a quiet dry studio. One coherent event with a natural tail. No comedy sucking, long squelch, cloth, shoe, ringing, tonal synth, pitch effect, distortion, speech or music.
